commentary.text: 90+9' The referee blows for the end of today's match.

90+8' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Yuito Suzuki (Freiburg) was quite harsh and Florian Badstubner didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card. It's a free kick to St. Pauli in a dangerous position.
90+5' Handball by Cyriaque Irie (Freiburg).
90+4' Hauke Wahl (St. Pauli) is caught offside, but it was a really close call.
90+3' The assistant referee raises his flag and the referee blows his whistle. Derry Scherhant (Freiburg) puts the ball into the net, but he is flagged for offside.
90+1' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by St. Pauli, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
90' 7 additional min. will be played.
89' Substitution. Patrick Osterhage (Freiburg) on for Johan Manzambi.
89' Alexander Blessin has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Martijn Kaars (St. Pauli) replacing Tomoya Ando.

87' Johan Manzambi (Freiburg) is furious with himself as he misses a golden opportunity from inside the six-yard box. He sends a rebound a few inches wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for St. Pauli.
86' Substitution. Lucas Holer (Freiburg) has come on for Igor Matanovic.
84' Here is a change. Mathias Rasmussen is going off and Alexander Blessin gives the last tactical orders to Connor Metcalfe (St. Pauli).
84' Here comes a substitution. Andreas Hountondji (St. Pauli) is brought on as a substitute for Mathias Pereira Lage.
82' Total attempts – 10:13.
80' Alexander Blessin appears to have said too much and referee Florian Badstubner comes over and theatrically shows him a yellow card.
78' 1 - 2 Goal! Igor Matanovic (Freiburg) was in the right place at the right time to pounce on the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball home. It's 1:2.
78' Cyriaque Irie (Freiburg) takes a good first touch from the pass, but mishits his shot low towards the middle of the goal and allows the Nikola Vasilj to make a comfortable save.
77' The attendance is 29546.
76' The goal by Freiburg won't count as it has been disallowed due to offside on the advice of the video assistant referee!
75' The Freiburg players halt their celebrations as referee Florian Badstubner makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
74' Cyriaque Irie (Freiburg) gets to the rebound in the goalmouth and plants a header home.
74' Freiburg will look to benefit from a promising free kick near the touchline.
72' St. Pauli enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.

70' Tomoya Ando (St. Pauli) controls a nice low pass and shoots from just outside the box, but it's a poor effort that flies into the stands. Wasted opportunity! The ball goes out of play and Freiburg will have a goal kick.
68' Julian Schuster has decided to make a change. Derry Scherhant (Freiburg) replaces Vincenzo Grifo.
68' Substitution. Lars Ritzka leaves the pitch and is replaced by Louis Oppie (St. Pauli).
65' 1 - 1 Igor Matanovic (Freiburg) receives the ball inside the box, reacts quickly and without any problems stabs the ball low inside the left post.

63' An accurate pass to the edge of the box is well taken by Lars Ritzka (St. Pauli), whose instinctive shot towards goal flashes inches over the top. The ball goes out of play and Freiburg will have a goal kick.
61' Igor Matanovic (Freiburg) is forced to stop his forward run after being caught in an offside position by the linesman.
60' Freiburg control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
58' Joel Fujita (St. Pauli) commits a rough challenge and Florian Badstubner blows his whistle for a foul.
56' Yuito Suzuki (Freiburg) receives a precise pass inside the box and takes a shot that flies just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for St. Pauli.
55' Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the right side of the target, but Nikola Vasilj easily deals with the threat.
52' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Freiburg comes to nothing.

52' Igor Matanovic (Freiburg) strikes the ball towards the top right corner of the goal and starts celebrating, but the goalkeeper denies him with a brilliant save. Freiburg will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
51' Matthias Ginter (Freiburg) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
49' Florian Badstubner has a clear sight and sees a foul from Jackson Irvine (St. Pauli).
48' Igor Matanovic (Freiburg) climbs high to connect with a cross near the penalty spot but plants a header high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and St. Pauli will have a goal kick.
46' Here is a change after the half-time break. Bruno Ogbus (Freiburg) is replaced by Philipp Lienhart.
46' Julian Schuster has made a change at the break. Cyriaque Irie (Freiburg) has come on in place of Jan-Niklas Beste.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+2' Florian Badstubner has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45' We will have 1 min. of added time.
44' The linesman makes the right call and Freiburg will have a corner.
44' Yuito Suzuki (Freiburg) reacts well to latch onto a rebound inside the box, but his shot is well blocked.
42' Mathias Pereira Lage (St. Pauli) commits a rough challenge and Florian Badstubner blows his whistle for an infringement.
41' Lars Ritzka (St. Pauli) clips an inviting cross into the box, but there's no one in a position to get on the end of it. The ball goes out of play and Freiburg will have a goal kick.
38' Lars Ritzka (St. Pauli) is caught offside by the linesman and it looks like it is the right decision despite being a very close call.
37' Hauke Wahl (St. Pauli) sends a weak shot high over the bar from the edge of the box. The ball goes out of play and Freiburg will have a goal kick.

35' The opposition back off Arkadiusz Pyrka (St. Pauli) and he lashes in a shot from the edge of the box that just flies over the bar. Unlucky! The ball goes out of play and Freiburg will have a goal kick.

34' Freiburg are playing possession football and controlling the game at present. They are exchanging inch-perfect passes from player to player, making it difficult for the opposition to win the ball.
32' Mathias Pereira Lage (St. Pauli) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Florian Badstubner has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
31' The resulting set piece from St. Pauli is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

31' Hauke Wahl (St. Pauli) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to St. Pauli.
29' Tomoya Ando (St. Pauli) makes a rough challenge and Florian Badstubner blows his whistle for a foul.
27' Danel Sinani (St. Pauli) starts his run too early and the referee blows for offside.

25' Maximilian Eggestein (Freiburg) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Florian Badstubner with no other option than to blow for a foul.

24' 1 - 0 Danel Sinani (St. Pauli) is in the right place at the right to get to the rebound, and from close range he sends the ball into the back of the net. He makes it 1:0. Tomoya Ando claims the assist.
24' The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for St. Pauli.
21' Mathias Rasmussen (St. Pauli) shakes off the attention of a defender and from mid-range lets fly towards the middle of the goal, but Noah Atubolu is well positioned to make a comfortable save.
18' Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) receives a pass inside the box, controls the ball and drills it towards the left post. Unfortunately for him, Nikola Vasilj makes a great save to stop his effort.
18' Joel Fujita (St. Pauli) aims for the middle of the goal, but that's an easy job for the goalkeeper. It will take more than that to test him!
17' St. Pauli seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
15' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Freiburg, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
14' Tomoya Ando (St. Pauli) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Florian Badstubner had an easy-decision to make. Freiburg earn a free kick.
12' Great teamplay by Freiburg as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
10' Danel Sinani (St. Pauli) is in a clear offside position and the linesman raises his flag.
9' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by St. Pauli, is overhit and the ball goes out of play.
8' Florian Badstubner blows his whistle. Philipp Treu (Freiburg) commits a foul after dangerous play. St. Pauli have a free kick.
6' Mathias Rasmussen (St. Pauli) gets to the rebound inside the box and shoots goalwards, but his sidefooter is blocked by an alert Noah Atubolu. What a save!
6' St. Pauli take a short corner kick.

5' Arkadiusz Pyrka (St. Pauli) sends a quick through ball into space for his teammate who is lurking close to the offside line, but one of the defenders intercepts and clears the danger. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to St. Pauli.

3' A brilliant individual effort! Jan-Niklas Beste (Freiburg) tricks his way past challenges into the box and drags his shot narrowly wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for St. Pauli.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Freiburg will kick the game off.
Florian Badstubner was nominated as the referee for this game.
